body:
Adds `research/rendezvous-twin` (builds on the ARPG multi-robot mapping direction; not affiliated): a twin fitted on short-horizon odometry sees only white noise, so it plans rendezvous too rarely and understates error. Closed-form cubic for the real optimum, error-budget violation, shared-bias cancellation in the pairwise frame, and a two-lag fitting repair. 8 tests, results from `experiments/run.py`, README bullet and `site/projects.json` entry added; `python site/build.py` prints ok.
